title: WATCH Viral Video: Mysterious Jellyfish-Like Object With Strange Tentacles Spotted Floating Over Alaska, UFO Or Alien? Bizarre Footage Goes Viral
excerpt: A mysterious jellyfish-like object with tentacle-like extensions was spotted floating over Anchorage, Alaska. Watch viral footage and discover why viewers are debating whether it was a UFO, drone or kite.
content:
A mysterious object resembling a giant jellyfish, complete with unusual tentacle-like extensions, has caught the attention of social media users after a woman captured it floating across the sky in Anchorage, Alaska. The bizarre footage, recorded while she was photographing a rainbow, has triggered widespread speculation online, with viewers debating whether the unidentified object was a UFO, an advanced drone, a specially designed kite or something else.

The unusual sighting has attracted attention because the dark object appeared to hover above a distant tree line, with several dangling extensions seemingly moving independently. The footage has also sparked questions because the object appeared to be travelling in the direction of Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, a major US military installation in Alaska. However, no official evidence has established a connection between the sighting and military activity, and the object’s identity remains unconfirmed.

Ok I found the person who filmed this ‘Jellyfish UFO’…Sara Osborn… She said: “I was taking pictures of the rainbow. It was the most vibrant rainbow I have ever seen in my WHOLE LIFE. And it was there… and then IT WAS. And we watched a plane fly by afterwards… whatever this thing was it was MASSIVE. I knew it wasn’t a kite. Kites have colors. And they fly those at the park strip… I was parked at the old Northway Mall when I filmed it. And we drove over to the park over there off of Muldoon – NOTHING. It was there. And then it wasn’t.”

WATCH Video: Mysterious Jellyfish-Like Object Spotted In Alaska Sky

The video was recorded by Sara Jane Osborn on June 15, 2026, while she was travelling with her husband in Anchorage. According to reports, she had stopped to photograph a rainbow when she noticed an unusual shape in the sky.

Osborn initially thought the object might be an insect appearing close to her phone camera. However, after looking beyond the screen, she realised that the strange shape was much farther away.

She subsequently recorded the object, which appeared dark, with a black-and-silver appearance and several long extensions resembling jellyfish tentacles.

The footage shows the unusual shape hovering against the distant landscape, prompting viewers to question what could produce such an extraordinary appearance. According to Osborn’s account, the object remained visible for approximately three minutes before disappearing.

Woman Captures Strange Object While Photographing Rainbow

Osborn reportedly noticed the object while photographing what she described as an exceptionally vibrant rainbow.

Her husband had pulled their vehicle over so she could take photographs without being disturbed by passing traffic. However, the unexpected sight in the sky quickly became the centre of their attention.

Osborn said the tentacle-like extensions appeared to move independently as the object shifted from side to side.

She also questioned whether it could be an ordinary kite, arguing that its movements looked unusual. The couple reportedly searched nearby areas after the object disappeared but could not identify anyone operating a similar kite.

The footage later circulated on social media, attracting attention from UFO enthusiasts and people interested in unexplained aerial sightings.

Is It A UFO, Alien Object Or Specially Designed Kite?

The unusual footage has divided social media users, with several explanations emerging about the object’s possible identity.

Some viewers have described it as a UFO because of its unusual shape and apparent movement. Others have suggested that it could be an advanced drone or an experimental flying device.

However, one of the most discussed explanations is that the object might be an octopus-shaped or jellyfish-style stunt kite. Such kites are designed with long fabric extensions that move independently in the wind, creating an appearance similar to tentacles.

A separate analysis published by Alaska News on November 13 also examined the possibility that the object was a kite. The report placed the filming location in East Anchorage and noted that nearby Russian Jack Springs Park is a known kite-flying location.

Nevertheless, the precise identity of the object has not been conclusively established.

Did The Mysterious Object Move Towards A US Military Base?

Another reason the video has attracted attention is the object’s apparent direction of movement towards Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson (JBER) in Anchorage.

The military installation is home to US Air Force units operating F-22 Raptor fighter aircraft and plays an important role in the country’s defence operations.

The apparent direction of the object has prompted online discussions about whether it could have been an unidentified aerial device.

However, there is no verified evidence that the object entered restricted military airspace, was detected by military radar or had any connection with the US military.

Its actual distance, altitude and size also remain uncertain because the footage does not establish how far away it was from the person recording it.

Why Is The Alaska Jellyfish-Like UFO Video Going Viral?

The unusual shape of the object, its apparently moving extensions and the circumstances surrounding its discovery have made the footage particularly intriguing.

Unlike conventional aerial sightings, the object appears to have a central body with several long structures hanging beneath it, creating a resemblance to a floating jellyfish.

The fact that it was captured while Osborn was photographing an ordinary rainbow has added another layer of curiosity to the incident. While some social media users have suggested extraterrestrial explanations, others believe a specially designed kite or another conventional airborne object could explain the unusual appearance. For now, the footage has generated more questions than answers.

Disclaimer: The identity of the object recorded in Anchorage, Alaska, has not been independently established. There is no confirmed evidence that it was an alien spacecraft, an extraterrestrial object or a military device. The kite and drone explanations also remain unconfirmed.
